Context: D. Mileage Allowance for Journeys by Road :

- GIO (1), Note 7, SR 46.  
2. Journey by Tonga, etc.Tonga, autorickshaw, cycle rickshaw and man-driven rickshaw are equated to journey by scooter I motor cycle. For travel by a friend's scooter as a pillion rider, the amount admissible will be half the prescribed rate or the actual cost of propulsion, whichever is less. - GIO (1), Notes 5 and 6, SR 46.
